lesson.title: Measuring Opa Distance

sections.title: Understanding the Opa Unit
sections.content: One opa unit is a way to measure distance. According to the source text, one opa unit equals four metres.

sections.title: Calculating Nine Units
sections.content:
To find the total distance of nine units, you multiply the number of units by the length of one unit.

Calculation:
9 units × 4 metres per unit = 36 metres.

The source text confirms that nine units measure thirty-six metres.

lesson.title: Understanding One Third

sections.title: What is a Third?
sections.content: One third means dividing a whole group into three equal parts. 'Equal' means that every part has the same number of items.

sections.title: Example: Sharing Apples
sections.content: If there are twelve apples and three people share them equally, each person gets four apples. In this example, four apples is one third of the twelve apples because it is one of three equal parts.

lesson.summary: One third is a way to describe one part of a whole that has been split into three equal pieces.

vocabulary.definition: Having the same number or amount.
One of three equal parts of a whole group.

discussion_questions: If you have three equal parts, how many parts make the whole group?
In the apple example, did each person get the same number of apples?
objectives: Explain one third in simple words
lesson.content:
One third means dividing a whole group into three equal parts. 'Equal' means that every part has the same number of items.

If there are twelve apples and three people share them equally, each person gets four apples. In this example, four apples is one third of the twelve apples because it is one of three equal parts.
